description: Repaired pi0.5 migration of the archive's four-task LIBERO continual-learning experiment; not a claim to reproduce OpenVLA numerical results
freeze_strategy: same balanced backbone/head boundary; CL orthogonal/frozen A, task B/gate bank isolation with current-row-only optimizer updates
checkpoint_retention: latest per group/stage; each final stage retained
uniform_budget: exact same source episodes and per-episode sample counts as the prototype group
normalization: per-task training data only, exact q01/q99 affine; replay/eval use the corresponding old task's statistics

tasks.name: pick up the black bowl next to the cookie box and place it on the plate
pick up the black bowl between the plate and the ramekin and place it on the plate
pick up the chocolate pudding and place it in the basket

protocol_repairs: Preserve original spatial6/spatial0/object8/goal7 sequence instead of the different reference pi05 taskA
Enable state tokens uniformly; reference discrete_state_input=False otherwise leaves pi05 without robot state
Use identical balanced backbone/head freeze boundary and budgets across four groups
Adapt LIBERO two-view/state8/action7 replay rather than RoboTwin three-view/state14
Interpret state rotation as axis-angle, not a quaternion slice
Protect previous/future task-bank rows during replay optimizer updates
Use low-host-memory native initialization, dynamic-model feature JIT, and image-free numeric column reads
